targetCohort: Young Indian commuters and students comparing treatment options for persistent, painful cheek breakouts.
readerTakeaway: Understand the differences between active ingredients and spot treatments to select the most suitable, non-irritating option for their cheek acne type.
objections: Believing that one active ingredient works for all cheek breakouts (e.g. using salicylic acid on deep cystic nodules).
Fearing that comparing products will lead to purchasing expensive, counter-productive regimens.
